analysis_readiness_configuration.description: Controlled analysis data cutoff, blinded aggregate checks, known-issue expected counts/dispositions, readiness prerequisites and portfolio-only readiness/closure claims.

blinded_analysis_readiness_review.description: Treatment-blind aggregate reconciliation of subject counts, randomized baseline coverage, end-of-study date completeness and configured data-cutoff compliance.

final_analysis_readiness_review.description: Final pre-closure review of prior data/metadata/standards gates plus explicit count reconciliation and disposition of retained analysis issues.

analysis_evidence_closure.description: Post-governance closure rule requiring analysis readiness, statistical change control and TLF traceability from the same clean workflow run without making a sponsor or regulatory readiness claim.
